raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" with a three-layered architecture. Layer 1 (Observe) uses lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns, application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation. Layer 2 (Intelligence Layer or "Brain") detects employee intent, the business value of tasks, and identifies "drift" where work deviates from intended flows. Narma leverages existing foundation models and focuses on the "Work Graph" to pinpoint resource consumption and identify opportunities for AI assistance. The system's vision is to observe work, decide AI actions, and continuously build agents for "Continuous AI lift."
raw.thesis:
Narma is developing an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies to address the significant challenges of deploying and scaling AI automation. The core innovation lies in its three-layered architecture: an observation layer that captures work patterns, an intelligence layer (the "Brain") that interprets employee intent and business value, and an auto-building agent layer. This system aims to provide continuous AI assistance by understanding how work is actually done, identifying inefficiencies, and automatically deploying AI agents to intercept work and provide assistance. It is designed to reveal where resources are wasted and where AI can intercede, ensuring a "Continuous AI lift."

Narma targets AI-first companies who are struggling to effectively implement and measure the ROI of AI automation. The problem Narma solves is the lack of clear telemetry for AI savings, unreliable ROI measurement, and constant "drift" in both systems and human processes. Narma repositions AI automation from a static deployment to a dynamic, continuously optimizing process. Instead of simply replacing existing solutions, it complements and enhances them by providing a foundational layer of intelligence and automation that observes, decides, and acts.

The founder's goal appears to be building a growth-stage startup, given the focus on "scale" and addressing enterprise-level problems. The venture is currently at the idea or concept stage, as the description focuses on the architecture and vision without mentioning any built product or user traction. The venture's positioning is unique as it doesn't replace existing AI models but rather sits alongside them, orchestrating and optimizing their deployment and impact within an organization by focusing on the "Work Graph."

core_insight.why_different: Narma focuses on observing the 'Work Graph' and leveraging existing foundation models to continuously auto-build agents rather than building its own LLMs, providing a dynamic and adaptive AI automation layer.
core_insight.if_wrong: If Narma cannot accurately detect employee intent or the business value of tasks from observed work patterns, its ability to effectively deploy and optimize AI automation will be undermined, leading to potentially irrelevant or disruptive AI assistance.
